question: Who was the Chief Guest at the 11th edition of the Raisina Dialogue in March 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alexander Stubb.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Chief Guest:** The President of Finland, **Alexander Stubb**, served as the Chief Guest for the **11th edition of the Raisina Dialogue** held in New Delhi in March 2026 (5th to 7th March).
 
• **Keynote Address:** President Stubb delivered the inaugural keynote address, emphasizing the importance of **multilateralism** and the role of the "Global North" and "Global South" in navigating a fractured world order.
 
• **Theme:** The theme of the 2026 edition is **"Saṁskāra – Assertion, Accommodation, Advancement”. **
 
• **Six thematic pillars:** (i) Contested Frontiers: Power, Polarity, and Periphery; (ii) Repairing the Commons: New Groups, New Guardians, New Avenues; (iii) White Whale: The Pursuit of Agenda 2030; (iv) The Eleventh Hour: Climate, Conflict, and the Cost of Delay; (v) Tomorrowland: Towards a Tech-topia; (vi) Trade in the Time of Tariffs: Recovery, Resilience, Reinvention

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Highlights of the Event__**

__
 
• **Organizers:** The conference is India’s flagship conference on geopolitics and geo-economics, hosted by the **Observer Research Foundation (ORF)** in collaboration with the **Ministry of External Affairs**.
 
• **Nordic Focus:** The presence of the Finnish President highlighted India's strengthening ties with **Nordic-Baltic countries**, particularly in areas of green energy, technology, and security.
 
• **Global Participation:** The 2026 dialogue saw participation from over 100 countries, including ministers, former heads of state, and technology leaders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **About Raisina Dialogue__**

 
• **Inception:** Launched in **2016**, the Raisina Dialogue has quickly become one of the most prominent global forums for discussing international relations.
 
• **Format:** It is designed as a multi-stakeholder, cross-sectoral discussion, involving heads of state, cabinet ministers, and local government officials, as well as thought leaders from the private sector and media.
 
• **Venue:** It is traditionally held in **New Delhi**, taking its name from Raisina Hill, the seat of the Government of India.
